# QS-CFW-4376-34 - Quality specification - valve body CFW-4376-34 (F316)
Revision: Rev C  
Plant: P3  
Parts: CFW-4376-34  
This revision supersedes Rev B.

## scope
This specification defines the quality acceptance criteria and inspection methods for forged valve body CFW-4376-34 (CFW-4376-34) manufactured from F316 material at plant P3. Applicable to finished forgings delivered for machining and assembly.

## requirements table
- Part: CFW-4376-34 (CFW-4376-34)  
- Material: F316  
- Hardness: The hardness range for valve body CFW-4376-34 (CFW-4376-34) is 28-32 HRC.  
- Critical bore: The bore diameter tolerance for valve body CFW-4376-34 (CFW-4376-34) is ±0.10 mm.  
- Forging weight: The maximum forging weight for valve body CFW-4376-34 (CFW-4376-34) is 46.2 kg.  
- Surface condition: Free of cracks, laps, and harmful folds; machining allowance to be confirmed by purchaser drawing.

## inspection method
Visual inspection to confirm general surface condition and absence of defects affecting integrity. Hardness testing shall be performed on finished forgings at locations per inspection plan; report values and confirm compliance with the hardness range for valve body CFW-4376-34 (CFW-4376-34) is 28-32 HRC. Dimensional inspection of the bore shall be performed using calibrated bore measurement equipment; confirm the bore diameter tolerance for valve body CFW-4376-34 (CFW-4376-34) is ±0.10 mm. Weigh the forging on calibrated scales to verify the maximum forging weight for valve body CFW-4376-34 (CFW-4376-34) is 46.2 kg; document actual weight on inspection record. Record all inspection results on the part inspection report and retain with lot documentation.

## nonconformance handling
Parts that fail any requirement shall be segregated and tagged. Notify quality and production leads and record findings on the nonconformance report. Disposition options include rework, scrap, or return to supplier as agreed. Rework or use-as-is dispositions require documented justification and approval by quality.
